scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @student/common build && pnpm --filter @student/api build:dev && concurrently -k -n common,api,web "pnpm --filter @student/common dev" "pnpm --filter @student/api dev" "pnpm --filter @student/web dev"
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @student/common build && pnpm db:generate && pnpm -r check
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @student/common build && pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @student/api test
scripts.openapi:generate: pnpm --filter @student/api... build && pnpm --filter @student/api openapi:export && pnpm --filter @student/common api:generate && pnpm --filter @student/common build
scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter @student/api... build && node packages/api/test/integration.mjs && node packages/api/test/workflow.mjs
